bots.name: Eris
bots.description: Chooses from valid moves without using strategy.
bots.focus: Useful as a baseline for comparing whether another strategy is actually helping.

bots.name: Ares
bots.description: Looks for chances to send opponent pawns back to their yard.
bots.focus: Values disruption: a capture can slow one opponent more than a small advance helps Ares.

bots.name: Athena
bots.description: Keeps pawns safe before looking for other moves.
bots.focus: Compares current danger with landing-square danger, preferring moves that reduce exposure.

bots.name: Hestia
bots.description: Brings pawns home as directly as possible.
bots.focus: Prefers the most progressed pawn, especially when a move brings it nearer to the home stretch.

bots.name: Apollo
bots.description: Balanced weighted bot combining capture, safety, progress, and activation.

bots.name: Your Bot
bots.description: Custom weighted bot configured with sliders.
bots.focus: Profile starts from Apollo, then follows the slider weights.

bots.name: Hermes
bots.description: Keeps pawns distributed across the board.
bots.focus: Avoids clustering by choosing moves that increase distance from friendly pawns already in play.

bots.name: Hephaestus
bots.description: Builds defensive stacks with friendly pawns.
bots.focus: Looks for moves that land on another friendly pawn to form a blockade.

bots.name: Artemis
bots.description: Gets pawns out of the yard whenever possible.
bots.focus: Prioritises activating new pawns so more pieces can join the chase.
